answer: Deposits are visible in marble, and ripple reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 49% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 84 aliases, and each one needs its own funded lantern account. Repeating the trick 20 times costs 17 separate deposits and 7 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
